claims.scope: Traders, especially algorithmic ones using round numbers, will encounter unexplained failures.

preconditions.text: A limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed through _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder.; The matched base amount and matched quote amount have no overlapping 1-bits (e.g., base = 256 and quote in 1..255, or 40 & 21).
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The zero-cost trade guard should trigger only when one side receives tokens without sending any, not merely when amounts have disjoint bits.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Traders, especially algorithmic ones using round numbers, will encounter unexplained failures.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The zero-cost trade guard is evaluated during limit order matching processing.
The matched base and quote amounts are observable quantities at guard evaluation time.

limitations: The intent's 'only when' is encoded as a conjunction of guard-triggered and one-side-receives-without-sending in the relation; the report does not provide a numeric definition of the zero-cost condition.
The impact is potential; the outcome symbol records the reported unexplained-failure occurrence without asserting inevitability.
Caller identity and authorization for triggering limit order matching are not stated and are not encoded.
